curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42058-1-1.pdf (the bike is steps 1-47, the ramp steps 48-50; page 47 shows the bike pulled back and launched at the ramp; the back cover's 42058 + 42059 model is a different build)

functions.does: Pull the bike back and let go: the pull-back motor drives the rear wheel through three 16 tooth gears, the middle one an idler, and the bike races forward.
functions.source: book: steps 1-4 (the pull-back motor), 6-8 and 15-17 (the gears and the rear wheel), page 47 (the hand pulling it back, the arrow forward)
functions.note: the pull-back motor's spring is what drives it; turning the rear wheel by hand only winds the motor's output shaft (p19) round with it

functions.does: The pull-back motor's spring winds up as the bike is pulled back and drives it forward when let go.
functions.skip: a spring only matters under force

functions.does: The stunt ramp, a printed cardboard sheet folded over two 9 long beams, stands on the ground for the bike to jump off.
functions.note: not a mechanism; the model file places the bike mid-jump just above the ramp
